articles.title: Ladakh Power Development Department Transfers Nine Engineers, Assigns New Charges - Kashmir Life
articles.full_text:
The transfers and postings have been ordered through Order No. 7 (LPDD) of 2026, issued by the Power Development and New and Renewable Energy Department on November 16, 2026, following the mapping of four allocated posts of Assistant Executive Engineers (AEE) in Pay Level 10A and officiating promotions granted to various engineers.
According to the order issued by Administrative Secretary, Power Development Department, Himanshu Gupta (IAS), the newly promoted and posted officials, as well as transferred engineers, shall be deemed to have been relieved with immediate effect.
As per the order, Stanzin Delegs, presently serving as In-charge AEE and In-charge AE in the Electrical Division Changthang, has been posted as In-charge AEE in the Electrical Division Sub-Division Leh, with additional charge of TD/STD.
Mohammad Hassan, presently In-charge AEE and In-charge AE in TD/STD Drass, has been posted as In-charge AEE in SLDC, with additional responsibilities relating to scheduling, monitoring and cyber security.
Mohammad Jaffer, presently In-charge AEE and In-charge AE in Electrical Division Sub-Division I Leh, has been posted as In-charge AEE in ED/TD/STD Sankoo.
Nissar Hussain, presently In-charge AEE and In-charge of ED Sub-Division I Kargil, has been posted as In-charge AEE in SLDC, with additional charge of Market Operation and Energy Accounting, besides AE Sub-Division I, ED Kargil.
Tashi Dolma, presently In-charge AEE in EDD Sub-Division Leh, has been assigned the responsibility of In-charge AEE, Commercial and IT.
Tashi Yangzom, presently In-charge AE in TD/STD Palam Kharu, has been posted as In-charge AE in ED Sub-Division I Leh, with the additional charge of a Junior Engineer (JE) already assigned to her.
Mohd Sadiq, presently In-charge AE and JE in City Section, ED Kargil, has been posted as In-charge AE in ED Sub-Division I Kargil, while retaining additional charges of JE already assigned to him.
Mustafa Kamal, presently In-charge AE and JE in ED Sub-Division Nubra, has been posted to Turtuk, with additional charge of the JE already assigned to him.
Shabeer Hussain, presently In-charge AE and JE in Durbuk Section, has been posted to TD/STD Changthang, with additional charge of the JE already assigned to him.
The order further directs the Chief Engineer, LPDD, to assign additional charges of Junior Engineers to In-charge Assistant Engineers and JEs as per requirements.
It also clarifies that Stanzin Dodjoo, Technical Officer to the Chief Engineer (Generation), will continue to function as the Nodal Officer of the State Load Despatch Centre (SLDC).
